response.original_title: Uncle Vanya From Moscow’s Vakhtangov Theater
response.overview: The Vakhtangov Theatre production of Uncle Vanya, directed by Rimas Tuminas, strips away cozy 19th-century realism for a stark, expressionist world. It focuses on raw emotional turmoil, dashed hopes, and unrequited love, turning an isolated country estate into a theatrical battlefield of human passions.
